Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            selfLink:
              title: Self link
              description: >-
                A relative link to this owner, formatted '/api/owners/<id>'.
              type: string
              example: '/api/owners/1'
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            salutation:
              title: Salutation
              description: >-
                The owner's salutation: the 'title' followed by a single space and
                the last name when a title is present (e.g. 'DR Franklin'), or just
                the last name when no title was supplied.
              type: string
              example: 'DR Franklin'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: >-
                The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName,
                dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone display
              description: >-
                The stored E.164 telephone formatted for humans: the country code, a
                space, then the national digits grouped in threes from the left (e.g.
                '+61 412 345 678'). The raw 'telephone' field stays in E.164 form.
              type: string
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The canonical region for the owner, read from the region segment of the
                memberId (the leading letters before the fiscal year), or 'UNKNOWN' when
                the postcode maps to no known region.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            timezone:
              title: Timezone
              description: >-
                The IANA timezone name derived from the owner's locality/region via the
                pinned region-to-timezone table (NSW -> Australia/Sydney,
                VIC -> Australia/Melbourne, QLD -> Australia/Brisbane), or absent when the
                region maps to no known timezone.
              type: string
              example: 'Australia/Sydney'
              readOnly: true
            memberId:
              title: Member ID
              description: >-
                The owner's unified member id, formatted '<REGION><FY><HASH8><CHK>' where
                REGION is the region code derived from the owner's postcode (NSW 2000-2099,
                VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099, else 'UNKNOWN'), FY is the two-digit fiscal
                year of the registrationDate (the fiscal year starts on 1 July), HASH8 is
                the first 8 upper-case hex characters of SHA-256 over the normalized
                telephone concatenated with the last name, and CHK is a single Luhn check
                digit computed over the digits of '<REGION><FY><HASH8>'. On a collision with
                an existing owner a '-<n>' suffix (smallest n from 2) is appended.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW261A2B3C4D7'
              readOnly: true
            fiscalYear:
              title: Fiscal year
              description: >-
                The fiscal year of the registrationDate, formatted 'FY<YY>' where YY is
                the last two digits of the fiscal year. The fiscal year starts on 1 July,
                so a registrationDate on or after 1 July belongs to that calendar year's
                fiscal year and one before 1 July belongs to the previous year's.
              type: string
              example: 'FY26'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                A stable, deterministic identifier for the household: the first 12 hex
                characters of SHA-256 over 'normalizedLastName|postcode', where the last
                name is compared case-insensitively with collapsed whitespace. Every owner
                carries one, so owners with the same last name and postcode share it
                automatically.
              type: string
              example: 'a1b2c3d4e5f6'
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: >-
                A derived key formatted 'normalizedTelephone|email|householdId', where email
                is empty when absent and householdId is the owner's deterministic household id.
                A create is rejected with a 409 when its whole identityKey equals an existing
                owner's (the same person), or when it shares an existing owner's household
                (same last name and postcode) unless it sets 'sharesHousehold'.
              type: string
              example: '+61412345678||'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of existing owners, at the time this owner was created,
                that share the same firstName and lastName (compared
                case-insensitively).
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: >-
                The owner's membership points. Starting from 0, add 2 when an email
                address is present, add 1 when the owner has no namesakes
                (namesakeCount is 0), add 2 for a household of 3 or more members, and
                add 3 when the owner's tenure exceeds one fiscal year (more than one
                elapsed fiscal year since the registrationDate).
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: >-
                The owner's numeric membership level, mapped from membershipPoints:
                level 1 for 0-1 points, 2 for 2-3, 3 for 4-5, and 4 for 6 or more.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            ownerSegment:
              title: Owner segment
              description: >-
                The owner's marketing segment, formatted '<TIER>_<AREA>'. TIER is
                'PREMIUM' when membershipLevel is 3 or more, otherwise 'STANDARD'.
                AREA is 'METRO' when the owner's locality is a known region
                (NSW, VIC or QLD), otherwise 'REGIONAL'. One of 'PREMIUM_METRO',
                'PREMIUM_REGIONAL', 'STANDARD_METRO' or 'STANDARD_REGIONAL'.
              type: string
              example: 'STANDARD_METRO'
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: >-
                The owner's preferred contact channel. 'EMAIL' when an email
                address is present, otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: >-
                The owner's age band, derived from birthDate when present and
                computed against the registrationDate: 'MINOR' when under 18,
                'ADULT' for 18-64, and 'SENIOR' for 65 and over. Absent when no
                birthDate was supplied.
              type: string
              example: 'ADULT'
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk sign-up warning
              description: >-
                True when more than 80 owners had already been created on this owner's
                registrationDate at the time this owner was created, otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            capacityWarning:
              title: Capacity warning
              description: >-
                True when, at the time this owner was created, its city already held
                between 40 and 49 owners (approaching the hard capacity limit of 50),
                otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicate:
              title: Possible duplicate
              description: >-
                True when, at the time this owner was created, it was not a hard
                duplicate but shared an existing owner's lastName and postcode while
                carrying a different telephone; otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicateOf:
              title: Possible duplicate of
              description: >-
                The id of the existing owner this owner possibly duplicates (same
                lastName and postcode, different telephone), set only when
                possibleDuplicate is true; otherwise absent.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            riskFlag:
              title: Risk flag
              description: >-
                True when the owner warrants a manual review because any one of the
                soft-risk signals holds: it is a possible duplicate (possibleDuplicate
                is true), its email domain is disposable-adjacent (not itself a blocked
                disposable domain, but sharing a blocked provider's second-level name
                under another TLD or carrying a throwaway-mail token), or its city is
                over its soft capacity (capacityWarning is true). Otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            deleted:
              title: Deleted
              description: >-
                Whether this owner has been soft-deleted. A newly created owner is
                false; DELETE /api/owners/{id} flags it true while retaining the
                record, and soft-deleted owners are ignored by the create endpoint's
                duplicate and identity checks.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - pets
    OwnerPage:
      title: Owner page
      description: A page of pet owners.
      type: object
      properties:
        content:
          title: Content
          description: Pet owners in the requested page.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/Owner'
        page:
          title: Page
          description: Zero-based page index.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 0
        size:
          title: Size
          description: Requested page size.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 1
          example: 5
        totalElements:
          title: Total elements
          description: Total number of owners matching the request.
          type: integer
          format: int64
          minimum: 0
          example: 10
        totalPages:
          title: Total pages
          description: Total number of pages matching the request.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 2
      required:
        - content
        - page
        - size
        - totalElements
        - totalPages
    PetPage:
      title: Pet page
      description: A page of pets.
      type: object
      properties:
        content:
          title: Content
          description: Pets in the requested page.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
        page:
          title: Page
          description: Zero-based page index.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 0
        size:
          title: Size
          description: Requested page size.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 1

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        title:
          title: Title
          description: >-
            The optional honorific title of the pet owner, one of MR, MRS, MS or
            DR. When present it is prefixed, followed by a single space, to the
            owner's last name to compose the 'salutation'.
          type: string
          pattern: "^(MR|MRS|MS|DR)$"
          example: DR
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: >-
            The postal address of the pet owner. Accepted on input for backward
            compatibility (the flat address form); when the structured
            'addressLine1'/'addressLine2' fields are supplied they are preferred.
            On create the returned value is the composed address: the normalized
            'addressLine1', with a single space and the normalized 'addressLine2'
            appended when 'addressLine2' is present. When only the flat form is
            supplied it is the normalized flat address.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: >-
            The first line of the structured postal address. Preferred over the
            flat 'address' when present. An owner is valid when it supplies an
            address in EITHER form — a non-blank 'addressLine1' or the flat
            'address'. Normalized like 'address' on create.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: >-
            The optional second line of the structured postal address. When
            present it is normalized and appended to the composed 'address' after
            a single space.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Apartment 4B'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. On create it is normalized to
            E.164 form: spaces, dashes and brackets are stripped; a leading '+' and
            country code are kept when present, otherwise country code '+61' is
            assumed and a single leading '0' is dropped from the national digits. It
            must carry 8 to 15 digits after the '+'; the stored and returned value is
            that E.164 string.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          example: '6085551023'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: >-
            The optional email address of the pet owner. When present it must be a
            syntactically valid address; it is stored and returned lower-cased. A
            present-but-invalid value is rejected with a 400.
          type: string
          format: email
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the pet owner was registered, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
            When omitted on create it defaults to the server's current date.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: >-
            The optional date of birth of the pet owner, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD'
            format. When present, the owner's 'ageBand' is derived from it,
            computed against the registrationDate.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            An optional 4-digit postcode. When present it must be valid for the
            owner's city region using the fixed table (NSW 2000-2099,
            VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099); a city with no known region accepts
            any 4-digit postcode. Stored and returned when given.
          type: string
          pattern: "^[0-9]{4}$"
          example: '2000'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            When true on create, allows an owner that shares a household with an
            existing owner — same last name (compared case-insensitively with
            collapsed whitespace) and same postcode — to be created as a declared
            household member instead of being rejected with a 409. A declared member
            is not flagged as a possible duplicate. It does not create the household
            link: the householdId is deterministic, so co-resident owners share it
            automatically.
          type: boolean
          example: true
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            selfLink:
              title: Self link
              description: >-
                A relative link to this owner, formatted '/api/owners/<id>'.
              type: string
              example: '/api/owners/1'
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            salutation:
              title: Salutation
              description: >-
                The owner's salutation: the 'title' followed by a single space and
                the last name when a title is present (e.g. 'DR Franklin'), or just
                the last name when no title was supplied.
              type: string
              example: 'DR Franklin'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: >-
                The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName,
                dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone display
              description: >-
                The stored E.164 telephone formatted for humans: the country code, a
                space, then the national digits grouped in threes from the left (e.g.
                '+61 412 345 678'). The raw 'telephone' field stays in E.164 form.
              type: string
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The canonical region for the owner, read from the region segment of the
                memberId (the leading letters before the fiscal year), or 'UNKNOWN' when
                the postcode maps to no known region.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            timezone:
              title: Timezone
              description: >-
                The IANA timezone name derived from the owner's locality/region via the
                pinned region-to-timezone table (NSW -> Australia/Sydney,
                VIC -> Australia/Melbourne, QLD -> Australia/Brisbane), or absent when the
                region maps to no known timezone.
              type: string
              example: 'Australia/Sydney'
              readOnly: true
            memberId:
              title: Member ID
              description: >-
                The owner's unified member id, formatted '<REGION><FY><HASH8><CHK>' where
                REGION is the region code derived from the owner's postcode (NSW 2000-2099,
                VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099, else 'UNKNOWN'), FY is the two-digit fiscal
                year of the registrationDate (the fiscal year starts on 1 July), HASH8 is
                the first 8 upper-case hex characters of SHA-256 over the normalized
                telephone concatenated with the last name, and CHK is a single Luhn check
                digit computed over the digits of '<REGION><FY><HASH8>'. On a collision with
                an existing owner a '-<n>' suffix (smallest n from 2) is appended.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW261A2B3C4D7'
              readOnly: true
            fiscalYear:
              title: Fiscal year
              description: >-
                The fiscal year of the registrationDate, formatted 'FY<YY>' where YY is
                the last two digits of the fiscal year. The fiscal year starts on 1 July,
                so a registrationDate on or after 1 July belongs to that calendar year's
                fiscal year and one before 1 July belongs to the previous year's.
              type: string
              example: 'FY26'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                A stable, deterministic identifier for the household: the first 12 hex
                characters of SHA-256 over 'normalizedLastName|postcode', where the last
                name is compared case-insensitively with collapsed whitespace. Every owner
                carries one, so owners with the same last name and postcode share it
                automatically.
              type: string
              example: 'a1b2c3d4e5f6'
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: >-
                A derived key formatted 'normalizedTelephone|email|householdId', where email
                is empty when absent and householdId is the owner's deterministic household id.
                A create is rejected with a 409 when its whole identityKey equals an existing
                owner's (the same person), or when it shares an existing owner's household
                (same last name and postcode) unless it sets 'sharesHousehold'.
              type: string
              example: '+61412345678||'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of existing owners, at the time this owner was created,
                that share the same firstName and lastName (compared
                case-insensitively).
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: >-
                The owner's membership points. Starting from 0, add 2 when an email
                address is present, add 1 when the owner has no namesakes
                (namesakeCount is 0), add 2 for a household of 3 or more members, and
                add 3 when the owner's tenure exceeds one fiscal year (more than one
                elapsed fiscal year since the registrationDate).
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: >-
                The owner's numeric membership level, mapped from membershipPoints:
                level 1 for 0-1 points, 2 for 2-3, 3 for 4-5, and 4 for 6 or more.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            ownerSegment:
              title: Owner segment
              description: >-
                The owner's marketing segment, formatted '<TIER>_<AREA>'. TIER is
                'PREMIUM' when membershipLevel is 3 or more, otherwise 'STANDARD'.
                AREA is 'METRO' when the owner's locality is a known region
                (NSW, VIC or QLD), otherwise 'REGIONAL'. One of 'PREMIUM_METRO',
                'PREMIUM_REGIONAL', 'STANDARD_METRO' or 'STANDARD_REGIONAL'.
              type: string
              example: 'STANDARD_METRO'
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: >-
                The owner's preferred contact channel. 'EMAIL' when an email
                address is present, otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: >-
                The owner's age band, derived from birthDate when present and
                computed against the registrationDate: 'MINOR' when under 18,
                'ADULT' for 18-64, and 'SENIOR' for 65 and over. Absent when no
                birthDate was supplied.
              type: string
              example: 'ADULT'
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk sign-up warning
              description: >-
                True when more than 80 owners had already been created on this owner's
                registrationDate at the time this owner was created, otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            capacityWarning:
              title: Capacity warning
              description: >-
                True when, at the time this owner was created, its city already held
                between 40 and 49 owners (approaching the hard capacity limit of 50),
                otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicate:
              title: Possible duplicate
              description: >-
                True when, at the time this owner was created, it was not a hard
                duplicate but shared an existing owner's lastName and postcode while
                carrying a different telephone; otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicateOf:
              title: Possible duplicate of
              description: >-
                The id of the existing owner this owner possibly duplicates (same
                lastName and postcode, different telephone), set only when
                possibleDuplicate is true; otherwise absent.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            riskFlag:
              title: Risk flag
              description: >-
                True when the owner warrants a manual review because any one of the
                soft-risk signals holds: it is a possible duplicate (possibleDuplicate
                is true), its email domain is disposable-adjacent (not itself a blocked
                disposable domain, but sharing a blocked provider's second-level name
                under another TLD or carrying a throwaway-mail token), or its city is
                over its soft capacity (capacityWarning is true). Otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            deleted:
              title: Deleted
              description: >-
                Whether this owner has been soft-deleted. A newly created owner is
                false; DELETE /api/owners/{id} flags it true while retaining the
                record, and soft-deleted owners are ignored by the create endpoint's
                duplicate and identity checks.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - pets
    OwnerPage:
      title: Owner page
      description: A page of pet owners.
      type: object
      properties:
        content:
          title: Content
          description: Pet owners in the requested page.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/Owner'
        page:
          title: Page
          description: Zero-based page index.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 0
        size:
          title: Size
          description: Requested page size.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 1
          example: 5
        totalElements:
          title: Total elements
          description: Total number of owners matching the request.
          type: integer
          format: int64
          minimum: 0
          example: 10
        totalPages:
          title: Total pages
          description: Total number of pages matching the request.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 2
      required:
        - content
        - page
        - size
        - totalElements

lines: -                The owner's unified member id, formatted '<REGION><FY><HASH8><CHK>' where
-                REGION is the region code derived from the owner's postcode (NSW 2000-2099,
-                VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099, else 'UNKNOWN'), FY is the two-digit fiscal
-                year of the registrationDate (the fiscal year starts on 1 July), HASH8 is
-                the first 8 upper-case hex characters of SHA-256 over the normalized
-                telephone concatenated with the last name, and CHK is a single Luhn check
-                digit computed over the digits of '<REGION><FY><HASH8>'. On a collision with
-                an existing owner a '-<n>' suffix (smallest n from 2) is appended.
+                The owner identity API version. Fixed at 2 for the version-2 identity release,
+                which mixes a fixed 'V2' version tag into every derived identifier and groups
+                the identifiers under the nested 'identity' object.

                (same last name and postcode) unless it sets 'sharesHousehold'.
              type: string
              example: '+61412345678||'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        title:
          title: Title
          description: >-
            The optional honorific title of the pet owner, one of MR, MRS, MS or
            DR. When present it is prefixed, followed by a single space, to the
            owner's last name to compose the 'salutation'.
          type: string
          pattern: "^(MR|MRS|MS|DR)$"
          example: DR
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: >-
            The postal address of the pet owner. Accepted on input for backward
            compatibility (the flat address form); when the structured
            'addressLine1'/'addressLine2' fields are supplied they are preferred.
            On create the returned value is the composed address: the normalized
            'addressLine1', with a single space and the normalized 'addressLine2'
            appended when 'addressLine2' is present. When only the flat form is
            supplied it is the normalized flat address.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: >-
            The first line of the structured postal address. Preferred over the
            flat 'address' when present. An owner is valid when it supplies an
            address in EITHER form — a non-blank 'addressLine1' or the flat
            'address'. Normalized like 'address' on create.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: >-
            The optional second line of the structured postal address. When
            present it is normalized and appended to the composed 'address' after
            a single space.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Apartment 4B'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. On create it is normalized to
            E.164 form: spaces, dashes and brackets are stripped; a leading '+' and
            country code are kept when present, otherwise country code '+61' is
            assumed and a single leading '0' is dropped from the national digits. It
            must carry 8 to 15 digits after the '+'; the stored and returned value is
            that E.164 string.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          example: '6085551023'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: >-
            The optional email address of the pet owner. When present it must be a
            syntactically valid address; it is stored and returned lower-cased. A
            present-but-invalid value is rejected with a 400.
          type: string
          format: email
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the pet owner was registered, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
            When omitted on create it defaults to the server's current date.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: >-
            The optional date of birth of the pet owner, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD'
            format. When present, the owner's 'ageBand' is derived from it,
            computed against the registrationDate.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            An optional 4-digit postcode. When present it must be valid for the
            owner's city region using the fixed table (NSW 2000-2099,
            VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099); a city with no known region accepts
            any 4-digit postcode. Stored and returned when given.
          type: string
          pattern: "^[0-9]{4}$"
          example: '2000'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            When true on create, allows an owner that shares a household with an
            existing owner — same last name (compared case-insensitively with
            collapsed whitespace) and same postcode — to be created as a declared
            household member instead of being rejected with a 409. A declared member
            is not flagged as a possible duplicate. It does not create the household
            link: the householdId is deterministic, so co-resident owners share it
            automatically.
          type: boolean
          example: true
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            selfLink:
              title: Self link
              description: >-
                A relative link to this owner, formatted '/api/owners/<id>'.
              type: string
              example: '/api/owners/1'
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            salutation:
              title: Salutation
              description: >-
                The owner's salutation: the 'title' followed by a single space and
                the last name when a title is present (e.g. 'DR Franklin'), or just
                the last name when no title was supplied.
              type: string
              example: 'DR Franklin'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: >-
                The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName,
                dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone display
              description: >-
                The stored E.164 telephone formatted for humans: the country code, a
                space, then the national digits grouped in threes from the left (e.g.
                '+61 412 345 678'). The raw 'telephone' field stays in E.164 form.
              type: string
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The canonical region for the owner, read from the region segment of the
                memberId (the leading letters before the fiscal year), or 'UNKNOWN' when
                the postcode maps to no known region.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            timezone:
              title: Timezone
              description: >-
                The IANA timezone name derived from the owner's locality/region via the
                pinned region-to-timezone table (NSW -> Australia/Sydney,
                VIC -> Australia/Melbourne, QLD -> Australia/Brisbane), or absent when the
                region maps to no known timezone.
              type: string
              example: 'Australia/Sydney'
              readOnly: true
            apiVersion:
              title: API version
              description: >-
                The owner identity API version. Fixed at 2 for the version-2 identity release,
                which mixes a fixed 'V2' version tag into every derived identifier and groups
                the identifiers under the nested 'identity' object.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            identity:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerIdentity'
            fiscalYear:
              title: Fiscal year
              description: >-
                The fiscal year of the registrationDate, formatted 'FY<YY>' where YY is
                the last two digits of the fiscal year. The fiscal year starts on 1 July,
                so a registrationDate on or after 1 July belongs to that calendar year's
                fiscal year and one before 1 July belongs to the previous year's.
              type: string
              example: 'FY26'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                A stable, deterministic identifier for the household: the first 12 hex
                characters of SHA-256 over 'normalizedLastName|postcode', where the last
                name is compared case-insensitively with collapsed whitespace. Every owner
                carries one, so owners with the same last name and postcode share it
                automatically.
              type: string
              example: 'a1b2c3d4e5f6'
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: >-
                A derived key formatted 'normalizedTelephone|email|householdId', where email
                is empty when absent and householdId is the owner's deterministic household id.
                A create is rejected with a 409 when its whole identityKey equals an existing
                owner's (the same person), or when it shares an existing owner's household
                (same last name and postcode) unless it sets 'sharesHousehold'.
              type: string
              example: '+61412345678||'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of existing owners, at the time this owner was created,
                that share the same firstName and lastName (compared
                case-insensitively).
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: >-
                The owner's membership points. Starting from 0, add 2 when an email
                address is present, add 1 when the owner has no namesakes
                (namesakeCount is 0), add 2 for a household of 3 or more members, and
                add 3 when the owner's tenure exceeds one fiscal year (more than one
                elapsed fiscal year since the registrationDate).
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: >-
                The owner's numeric membership level, mapped from membershipPoints:
                level 1 for 0-1 points, 2 for 2-3, 3 for 4-5, and 4 for 6 or more.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            ownerSegment:
              title: Owner segment
              description: >-
                The owner's marketing segment, formatted '<TIER>_<AREA>'. TIER is
                'PREMIUM' when membershipLevel is 3 or more, otherwise 'STANDARD'.
                AREA is 'METRO' when the owner's locality is a known region
                (NSW, VIC or QLD), otherwise 'REGIONAL'. One of 'PREMIUM_METRO',
                'PREMIUM_REGIONAL', 'STANDARD_METRO' or 'STANDARD_REGIONAL'.
              type: string
              example: 'STANDARD_METRO'
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: >-
                The owner's preferred contact channel. 'EMAIL' when an email
                address is present, otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: >-
                The owner's age band, derived from birthDate when present and
                computed against the registrationDate: 'MINOR' when under 18,
                'ADULT' for 18-64, and 'SENIOR' for 65 and over. Absent when no
                birthDate was supplied.
              type: string
              example: 'ADULT'
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk sign-up warning
              description: >-
                True when more than 80 owners had already been created on this owner's
                registrationDate at the time this owner was created, otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            capacityWarning:
              title: Capacity warning
              description: >-
                True when, at the time this owner was created, its city already held
                between 40 and 49 owners (approaching the hard capacity limit of 50),
                otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicate:
              title: Possible duplicate
              description: >-
                True when, at the time this owner was created, it was not a hard
                duplicate but shared an existing owner's lastName and postcode while
                carrying a different telephone; otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicateOf:
              title: Possible duplicate of
              description: >-
                The id of the existing owner this owner possibly duplicates (same
                lastName and postcode, different telephone), set only when
                possibleDuplicate is true; otherwise absent.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            riskFlag:
              title: Risk flag
              description: >-
                True when the owner warrants a manual review because any one of the
                soft-risk signals holds: it is a possible duplicate (possibleDuplicate
                is true), its email domain is disposable-adjacent (not itself a blocked
                disposable domain, but sharing a blocked provider's second-level name
                under another TLD or carrying a throwaway-mail token), or its city is
                over its soft capacity (capacityWarning is true). Otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            deleted:
              title: Deleted
              description: >-
                Whether this owner has been soft-deleted. A newly created owner is
                false; DELETE /api/owners/{id} flags it true while retaining the
                record, and soft-deleted owners are ignored by the create endpoint's
                duplicate and identity checks.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - pets
    OwnerPage:

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        title:
          title: Title
          description: >-
            The optional honorific title of the pet owner, one of MR, MRS, MS or
            DR. When present it is prefixed, followed by a single space, to the
            owner's last name to compose the 'salutation'.
          type: string
          pattern: "^(MR|MRS|MS|DR)$"
          example: DR
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: >-
            The postal address of the pet owner. Accepted on input for backward
            compatibility (the flat address form); when the structured
            'addressLine1'/'addressLine2' fields are supplied they are preferred.
            On create the returned value is the composed address: the normalized
            'addressLine1', with a single space and the normalized 'addressLine2'
            appended when 'addressLine2' is present. When only the flat form is
            supplied it is the normalized flat address.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: >-
            The first line of the structured postal address. Preferred over the
            flat 'address' when present. An owner is valid when it supplies an
            address in EITHER form — a non-blank 'addressLine1' or the flat
            'address'. Normalized like 'address' on create.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: >-
            The optional second line of the structured postal address. When
            present it is normalized and appended to the composed 'address' after
            a single space.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Apartment 4B'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. On create it is normalized to
            E.164 form: spaces, dashes and brackets are stripped; a leading '+' and
            country code are kept when present, otherwise country code '+61' is
            assumed and a single leading '0' is dropped from the national digits. It
            must carry 8 to 15 digits after the '+'; the stored and returned value is
            that E.164 string.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          example: '6085551023'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: >-
            The optional email address of the pet owner. When present it must be a
            syntactically valid address; it is stored and returned lower-cased. A
            present-but-invalid value is rejected with a 400.
          type: string
          format: email
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the pet owner was registered, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
            When omitted on create it defaults to the server's current date.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: >-
            The optional date of birth of the pet owner, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD'
            format. When present, the owner's 'ageBand' is derived from it,
            computed against the registrationDate.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            An optional 4-digit postcode. When present it must be valid for the
            owner's city region using the fixed table (NSW 2000-2099,
            VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099); a city with no known region accepts
            any 4-digit postcode. Stored and returned when given.
          type: string
          pattern: "^[0-9]{4}$"
          example: '2000'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            When true on create, allows an owner that shares a household with an
            existing owner — same last name (compared case-insensitively with
            collapsed whitespace) and same postcode — to be created as a declared
            household member instead of being rejected with a 409. A declared member
            is not flagged as a possible duplicate. It does not create the household
            link: the householdId is deterministic, so co-resident owners share it
            automatically.
          type: boolean
          example: true

        - firstName
        - lastName
        - city
        - telephone

              readOnly: true

              type: integer
              format: int32
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            identity:

            fiscalYear:
              title: Fiscal year
              description: >-

                the last two digits of the fiscal year. The fiscal year starts on 1 July,

              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true

              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:

OwnerIdentity:
      title: Owner identity
      description: >-
        The owner's version-2 identity: the derived identifiers, grouped together. Every value mixes
        in a fixed 'V2' version tag, so no identifier repeats a value produced under version 1. The tag
        is confined to these identifiers and never appears in the user-facing 'locality', 'timezone' or
        owner-segment region.
      type: object
      properties:
        memberId:
          title: Member ID
          description: >-
            The owner's unified member id, formatted '<REGION><FY><HASH8><CHK>' where REGION is the
            version-2 region code — the plain region derived from the owner's postcode (NSW 2000-2099,
            VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099, else 'UNKNOWN') with the fixed 'V2' version tag mixed in
            (e.g. 'NSWV2') — FY is the two-digit fiscal year of the registrationDate (the fiscal year
            starts on 1 July), HASH8 is the first 8 upper-case hex characters of SHA-256 over the
            normalized telephone concatenated with the last name, and CHK is a single Luhn check digit
            computed over the digits of '<REGION><FY><HASH8>'. On a collision with an existing owner a
            '-<n>' suffix (smallest n from 2) is appended.
          type: string
          example: 'NSWV2261A2B3C4D7'
          readOnly: true
        householdId:
          title: Household ID
          description: >-
            A stable, deterministic identifier for the household: the first 12 hex characters of
            SHA-256 over 'V2|normalizedLastName|postcode', where the last name is compared
            case-insensitively with collapsed whitespace and the fixed 'V2' version tag ensures no
            value produced under version 1 is produced again. Every owner carries one, so owners with
            the same last name and postcode share it automatically.
          type: string
          example: 'a1b2c3d4e5f6'
          readOnly: true
        identityKey:
          title: Identity key
          description: >-

            where email is empty when absent and the fixed 'V2' version tag ensures no value produced
            under version 1 is produced again. A create is rejected with a 409 when its whole
            identityKey equals an existing owner's (the same person).
          type: string
          example: 'b1946ac92492d2347c6235b4d2611184'
          readOnly: true

      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        title:
          title: Title
          description: >-
            The optional honorific title of the pet owner, one of MR, MRS, MS or
            DR. When present it is prefixed, followed by a single space, to the
            owner's last name to compose the 'salutation'.
          type: string
          pattern: "^(MR|MRS|MS|DR)$"
          example: DR
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: >-
            The postal address of the pet owner. Accepted on input for backward
            compatibility (the flat address form); when the structured
            'addressLine1'/'addressLine2' fields are supplied they are preferred.
            On create the returned value is the composed address: the normalized
            'addressLine1', with a single space and the normalized 'addressLine2'
            appended when 'addressLine2' is present. When only the flat form is
            supplied it is the normalized flat address.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: >-
            The first line of the structured postal address. Preferred over the
            flat 'address' when present. An owner is valid when it supplies an
            address in EITHER form — a non-blank 'addressLine1' or the flat
            'address'. Normalized like 'address' on create.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: >-
            The optional second line of the structured postal address. When
            present it is normalized and appended to the composed 'address' after
            a single space.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Apartment 4B'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. On create it is normalized to
            E.164 form: spaces, dashes and brackets are stripped; a leading '+' and
            country code are kept when present, otherwise country code '+61' is
            assumed and a single leading '0' is dropped from the national digits. It
            must carry 8 to 15 digits after the '+'; the stored and returned value is
            that E.164 string.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          example: '6085551023'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: >-
            The optional email address of the pet owner. When present it must be a
            syntactically valid address; it is stored and returned lower-cased. A
            present-but-invalid value is rejected with a 400.
          type: string
          format: email
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the pet owner was registered, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
            When omitted on create it defaults to the server's current date.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: >-
            The optional date of birth of the pet owner, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD'
            format. When present, the owner's 'ageBand' is derived from it,
            computed against the registrationDate.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            An optional 4-digit postcode. When present it must be valid for the
            owner's city region using the fixed table (NSW 2000-2099,
            VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099); a city with no known region accepts
            any 4-digit postcode. Stored and returned when given.
          type: string
          pattern: "^[0-9]{4}$"
          example: '2000'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            When true on create, allows an owner that shares a household with an

All green — build succeeds and the single acceptance test passes. The audit line in the run confirms the new behaviour end-to-end: `memberId=NSWV22616E6609E9` and the structured event `{"seq":1,...,"event":"OWNER_CREATED","schemaVersion":2}`.

## Summary

Released version 2 of the owner identity. The `V2` tag is mixed into every derived identifier while user-facing region fields stay plain.

**Identity derivation (V2 tag mixed in, so no V1 value recurs):**
- `IdentityVersion` (new, `rest/function/common`) — single home of `TAG = "V2"` and `VERSION = 2`.
- `HouseholdKey` — householdId is now `SHA-256("V2|" + normalizedLastName + "|" + postcode)[0..12]`.
- `IdentityKey` — key is now `SHA-256("V2|" + tel + "|" + email + "|" + soundex(lastName))`; both the duplicate check and the mapper route through it, so they stay consistent.
- `AssignOwnerMemberId` — the region embedded in the memberId is now `plainRegion + "V2"` (e.g. `NSWV2…`), so every memberId changes.

**User-facing region stays plain (tag never leaks):**
- `OwnerMapper.locality` now derives the plain region directly from the postcode (`Localities.ofPostcode`) instead of reading it back out of the memberId. `timezone` and `ownerSegment` continue to use that plain region, so `NSW` → `Australia/Sydney` → `…_METRO` are unchanged.
- `MemberId.regionOf` was removed — it could no longer parse a region containing the tag's digit, and nothing else used it.

**Response shape:**
- `openapi.yml` — new `OwnerIdentity` schema (`memberId`, `householdId`, `identityKey`); `Owner` gains a nested `identity` object and a top-level integer `apiVersion`, and the three identifiers are removed from the top level. `OwnerMapper` builds the nested object and stamps `apiVersion = 2`.

**Audit schema:**
- `OwnerCreatedEvent` gains `schemaVersion` (2); `AuditOwnerCreated` passes `IdentityVersion.VERSION`. Its `memberId` slot already carries the (now V2) primary identifier.

Javadoc and OpenAPI descriptions across the touched files were updated to match.
